data.title: Amazi Hawana Salalah
data.about:
Embrace Elegance at Amazi, Hawana Salalah, Oman: Where Luxury Meets Seaside Serenity!

Dive into opulence at the heart of Hawana Salalah's latest residential revelation, nestled along the pristine shores of the Arabian Sea. Here, luxury is multiplied across four unique neighborhoods, each offering a curated choice of spectacular 1 and 2 bedroom beachfront chalets or grand 2 to 4 bedroom villas, all promising awe-inspiring waterfront views. Indulge in unparalleled resort-style living with Amazi's first-class amenities, setting the gold standard in comfort and luxury. Discover the most prestigious endeavor of Hawana Salalah, brought to life by the collective genius of Muriya, Orascom Development, and OMRAN. Amazi isn't just a home; it's your gateway to Oman's blossoming cultural and residential epicenter, where your dream lifestyle becomes an everyday reality, enriching your life beyond compare!

characteristics_module.title: Your stunning oceanfront home awaits!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Neighbourhood spread over 1 Million Sqft.
  • Large land plots and spacious gardens.
  • World class amenities near Arabian coastline.
  • 7km of stunning white sandy beach.
  • Tranquil waterfront and lagoon views.
  • Private resort style homes.
  • Community inspired by Wadi Darbat
  • Exciting Beachfront Lifestyle.
  • Swimmable Lagoons.

location_tile.title: Sparkling on the shore next to an iridescent Arabian Sea
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description: Find your slice of paradise at Amazi, Located in the heart of the renowned Hawana Salalah resort community in the Sultanate of Oman. A mere 25-minute journey to the centre of the city of Salalah and Salalah International Airport, this luxury retreat is a gateway for visitors flying in from the Emirates, Europe, and all corners of the globe, offering an exotic haven of ease and opulence.
